title: Relay-backed SBOM availability-list merge
observed_behavior: Before this slice, the SBOM orchestrator rebuilt canonical 30004 availability lists from local projection entries only, so valid relay-published references could be dropped when replacing the complete list.
intended_behavior: Before replacing a subject-scoped kind 30004 SBOM availability list, Bahia subscribes to the current canonical list with an exact filter, validates relay events, waits for EOSE historical catch-up, merges/dedupes relay and local entries, then publishes the complete replacement only after relay OK acceptance.
